about:
Progressive Industrial Electrical, Inc. (P-I-E) was established in 2008 in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company has been locally owned and operated since its inception, founded on the principle that strong customer relationships are built through high-quality services at fair prices, with an emphasis on integrity and transparency.

The firm operates as a full-service industrial electrical contractor and a UL 508A-listed panel shop. Its service portfolio spans high-, medium-, and low-voltage power distribution, including pole setting, overhead line work, switchgear and transformer installation, motor control center (MCC) and variable frequency drive (VFD) installation and commissioning. In-house capabilities extend to electrical design using AutoCAD Electrical, PLC and SCADA system design, programming, and upgrades, HMI programming, instrument installation and calibration, and industrial communications such as fiber and copper Ethernet and network configuration.

P-I-E serves industrial clients across sectors that require electrical infrastructure, control systems, and automation solutions, though the company does not publicly list specific industry verticals or named customers.

P-I-E was founded on the principle that strong customer relationships are formed by offering high-quality services at fair prices, emphasizing integrity and transparency. A stated differentiator is the company's in-house SCADA and controls capabilities, which it notes sets it apart from other contractors.
